query:
UPDATE contacts SET
                 state = $3,
                 confirmed_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'confirmed' THEN $5 ELSE confirmed_at END,
                 active_at = COALESCE($4, active_at),
                 closed_at = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $5 ELSE closed_at END
               WHERE contact_id = $1 AND state = ANY($2)
